en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.
Launch preparation: Researched ZUS Coffee consumer preferences, social feedback and competitor content, organized product messages and prepared promotional themes and channel assets.

Channel execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts through planning, shooting, editing and English copy. Coordinated online launches and FamilyMart promotion with store information, assets and publishing schedules.
Weekly reviews: Tracked reach, engagement and follower changes; completed 15+ content reviews and proposed adjustments to topics and timing. Contributed to account follower growth of 11k+.

Channel events: Coordinated university needs, schedules and task lists; worked with product and business teams on demos, FAQs, teaching cases and course materials. Supported on-site Q&A and consolidated 10 suggestions for follow-up pilots.

Feedback analysis: Managed user communities and classified 100+ feedback items across teaching, lesson preparation and self-study. Summarized recurring issues and barriers for channel communication and event improvements.

Reusable materials: Built the product WeChat content program from scratch and produced 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and cases. Consolidated reusable product and support materials; core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.

Partnership follow-up: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation by organizing requirements, responsibilities and handover materials and tracking agreement signing and implementation progress.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

Channel reporting: Consolidated impressions, clicks, registrations and active-user data; checked definitions and prepared weekly reports. Used AI to build a lightweight operations dashboard and identify user drop-off points.
Workflow documentation: Helped organize requirement collection, content review, publication and review workflows. Documented deadlines, FAQs, SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Daily channel support: Maintained creator records, content schedules and asset lists. Produced 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts and followed up on assets, publication status and feedback.

Campaign execution: Planned touchpoints by user stage, independently designed selected online acquisition activities and supported offline event preparation. Tested headlines, covers and content; registrations increased 50% versus the previous week and first-topic creation rate rose approximately 15% relatively.

skills: Profile: 2027 Master of Marketing candidate; English as a working language. Experience in channel operations, reporting, workflow documentation and cross-team support.
Capabilities: Channel monitoring, reporting, campaign schedules, asset management, documentation and partnership follow-up.
AI tools: AI-assisted operations dashboards, copy and creative production, data analysis, SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Analytics: Excel, SPSS and basic SQL; channel testing, communication tracking and campaign reviews.
